newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: UnionBank sets $500 mln medium term note.
newsitem.headline: UnionBank sets $500 mln medium term note.

text.p: The UnionBank of the Philippines said on Friday it had embarked on a $500 million global medium-term note programme.
In a statement, the bank said it had signed an agreement last Monday with Merrill Lynch International to arrange the programme.
UnionBank said under the programme, it may issue notes and certificates of deposits (CDs) in an amount outstanding at any time of up to $500 million or its equivalent in other currencies.
Last November 27, UnionBank had the inaugural issue of $75 million unlisted floating rate certificates of deposit. The issue will be due in 2001.
